Subject: Re: Post-demo - inference economics

Marissa,

Thanks for the demo today. Short recap from our side:
- Primary pain: token spend variability — month-to-month spend spikes when marketing sends campaigns (~4x baseline)
- Latency SLO: 200ms p95 on search rerank; current infra often misses during peaks
- Security: need SOC2 evidence and data retention controls
- Budget: leadership comfortable with ~$10k/mo for pilot but need clear ROI

We'll pull a 30-day token export (attached) and share.

Next: can you put together a short draft pilot plan that shows expected unit economics and what levers (batching, prefix cache, quantization) you plan to test?

Alec
Head of ML, FinFlow

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alec Turner <alec.turner@finflow.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T18:24:00-07:00
Subject: Quantified token economics — follow-up and pilot asks

Alec — thanks for the crisp recap and for sending the export.

High-level read:
- 30-day snapshot: ~120M prompt+completion tokens, large spikes tied to campaign windows (~3.8x)
- Current cost baseline (rough): ~$23k/mo (model tiers and open-provider assumptions) — will refine with full export

Recommended pilot levers (3-week pilot, proof points):
1) Batching + request shaping: tune batching for peak windows; expected token reduction: 12–20% latency-neutral
2) KV/prefix caching for repeated prompts (search rerank prefixes): expected token reduction on repeat users: 8–15%
3) Mixed-precision / quantized variant for background reranks to cut per-token compute cost by ~25–35%
4) Routing policy: offload non-SLO requests to cheaper model variant during peaks

Preliminary economic envelope:
- Conservative estimate: 18–28% cost reduction
- Stretch: 30–45% if cache hit rates and batching align with your traffic patterns
- Operational ask: 1 reserved node pool for steady throughput + burst autoscale during campaigns (we can size)

Attachments: redwood_pilot_options_v1.pdf (pilot scopes and optional billable probe)

Next steps:
- Karthik / Soojin: can you size the 1-node reserved pool and a 3-week burst plan? Karthik — any immediate constraints from pricing side?
- Alec: once you confirm the CSV is final, we'll return a short pilot SOW + a conservative ROI table. Can we target Tuesday 8/18 to lock scope?

Short signature:
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
